NOTE
1. Expectant mothers should not apply
2. Certified copies of the following documents must be attached to this form: -
 (i) One copy of KCSE Certificate/Result slip.
 (ii) Two recent passport size photographs, (not photo me)
 (iii) One copy of identity card (both sides)
 (iv) A copy of co-curricular activity certificate obtained (if any)
 (v) One copy of School Leaving Certificate.
3. Candidates who register in more than one zone shall automatically be disqualified.
4. It is an offence to give false information.

PRIMARY TEACHERS TRAINING COLLEGES FOR THE YEAR 2021
PART 1 A (TO BE FILLED BY THE APPLICANT)
FULL NAME _____________________________________________________________
IDENTITY CARD NUMBER _________________________________________________
INDEX NO. ______________________________________________________________
ZONE_________________ SUB-COUNTY_______________
SIGNATURE ________________________________
1. ACADEMIC QUALIFICATION (TO BE COMPLETED BY THE ZONAL OFFICER)
In this part marks will be awarded for the Mean Grade obtained in accordance with
points shown below:
MEAN GRADE POINTS
 A - 12
 A- - 11
 B+ - 10
 B - 9
 B- - 8
 C+ - 7
 C - 6
 C- - 5
 D+ - 4
 D - 3
 D- - 2
 E - 1
Maximum marks for this part will be 12.
2. QUALITY OF CERTIFICATE
Candidates will be awarded marks based on the grade obtained in KCSE in 5 subjects
following the 12 points scale. The subjects are: - English, Mathematics, Kiswahili, best
science subject and any other 1 best subject. Maximum points for this part will be 60.
The following 12 points scale should be used when awarding individual subject marks:-
SUBJECT GRADE POINTS POINTS
 A - 12
 A- - 11
 B+ - 10
 B - 9
 B- - 8
 C+ - 7
 C - 6
 C- - 5
 D+ - 4
 D - 3
 C- - 2
 E - 1
3. CO-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES
A maximum of 8 marks will only be awarded for not more than one Co-Curricular
activity such as football music, debate, drama, scouting/girl guide, 4K club, etc., at the
highest level (National). Marks will be awarded on meritorious performance (evidence
of such certificate, testimonial letters, etc must be shown) and only for the highest level
at which the activity is performed. For example, if one has proof that one has a
meritorious performance at School, Zonal, Division and District levels, he/she will only
be awarded marks for the highest and not for all three levels.
Marks will be awarded as follows:-
 (i) School level - 2
 (ii) Zonal level - 3
 (iii) Divisional level - 5
 (iv) District level - 6
 (v) Provincial level - 7
 (vi) National level - 8
Maximum marks for this section will be 8.
4.0 LENGTH OF STAY SINCE KCSE
Marks will be awarded as follows:-
 a) 2010 and below - 20
 b) 2011 – 2012 - 15
 c) 2013 – 2014 - 10
 d) 2015 – 2019 - 5
 Maximum mark 20
5.0 MAXIMUM MARKS FOR ALL SECTIONS
The maximum marks for the three sections will be 100 points.
The marks should be tabulated as below:-
 1. Academic qualification
 2. Quality
 3. Co-curricular Activities
 4. Length of Stay since KCSE
 TOTAL
